observations: Photo 0 shows a Sony PlayStation 4 console with a DualShock 4 controller in its original retail packaging.
Photo 1 shows the same console and controller outside of the box, with the console's ports visible.
The console is a slim model with the 'PS4' logo on the front and 'SONY' on the side.
The controller is a black DualShock 4 with a clear plastic shell.
A USB cable is visible in both photos.
The console appears to be in good cosmetic condition.
